status.en: 24 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 23% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 24 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 23 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Israeli forces stepped up air operations over Syria and warned the Druze against renewed attacks, while Israeli fire killed a Syrian man and a security officer was martyred in an armed attack in the Daraa countryside. Protesters in Syria demonstrated against repeated Israeli incursions, blocking the Damascus-Suwayda road and demanding detainee releases. Security incidents were reported in Hama and Aleppo, and a Syrian security operation against a Daesh cell resulted in casualties. The Syrian Investment Authority and a Saudi ambassador discussed a joint food-security megaproject. 2732 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker intensiverte luftoperasjoner over Syria og advarte drusjene mot nye angrep, mens israelsk ild drepte en syrisk mann og en sikkerhetsoffiser ble martyr i et væpnet angrep på landsbygda i Daraa. Demonstranter i Syria protesterte mot gjentatte israelske inntrengninger, blokkerte veien mellom Damaskus og Suwayda og krevde løslatelse av fanger. Sikkerhetshendelser ble rapportert i Hama og Aleppo, og en syrisk sikkerhetsoperasjon mot en Daesh-celle førte til tap. Den syriske investeringsmyndigheten og en saudisk ambassadør diskuterte et felles matvaresikkerhetsmegaprojekt. 2732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
